topic: World-invariant pivot re-anchoring compensation versus naive origin shift
topic_zh: 世界坐标不变量支点切换补偿与直接改支点瞬移对比
scope: Deterministic affine pivot-shift compensation t₂ = t₁ + (R(θ₀)-I)Δp, C⁰ handoff continuity verification and Node CPU solving. No Dream2Flow video object flow or robotic grasp synthesis.

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating Node CPU runs after warmup. Direct affine vector compensation versus 4-matrix 3x3 homogeneous chain multiplication, not neural object flow or GPU rendering.

protocol.function: pivot shift Δp = p₂ - p₁ at θ₀ → compensate t₂ = t₁ + (R(θ₀)-I)Δp → 0 handoff pop → rotate around p₂

robustness.name: Handoff and post-switch frames retain exact world matrices under reverse visitation

good_fit: Multi-pivot walking mechanisms and alternating latches
Dynamic parent switching (table → hand → table) without frame pops
Interactive 3D gizmos allowing mid-animation pivot relocation
Explaining why T(t)·T(p)·R(θ)·T(-p) couples pivot and translation
not_for: Dream2Flow video-to-3D object flow neural extraction
Point-cloud robotic grasp synthesis and force closure
Frictional contact slip and impact impulse dynamics
